narr: A broken line of supercells formed on the evening of June 16th as a mid-level trough interfered with agitated cumulus clouds in northwestern Ohio and a lake breeze east of Lake Erie. Moderate to high instability and high wind shear, 35-45kts and 1500-2500J/kg, helped with robust convection.
ev: Media reported that flooding caused evacuations along State Route 821 between Belle Valley and Cambridge. Also the local emergency manager reported numerous roads closed due to flash flooding.
